product.title: Melbourne Street Art Tour

description.text: In Melbourne, this street-artist-led walk meets at ACMI on Flinders Street and continues through Hosier Lane and State Library Victoria before a studio visit at The Blender Studios. The published route is a laneway and studio circuit rather than a sports-precinct walk to the MCG. The format suits visitors who want working-studio time and laneway context without a Great Ocean Road coach. Meeting points are confirmed at ACMI in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those inner-city art stops that define this outing rather than a Yarra Valley balloon launch.

highlights: Hosier Lane and hidden CBD works
Blender Studios warehouse visit with snacks

start.description: Meet on Flinders St out the front of ACMI's Street Entrance, Federation Square, Flinders St, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
